accounting.baseline: Program AST, binder symbols/flow, file text and completed loader state exist before checking. Report them as bound-input storage. Preallocating or preinterning checker/type work before the boundary does not make it bound-input storage; it remains charged to the checker/type family.
accounting.complete: Census adapter reports every encountered allocation family. A missing size, unknown allocation extent, unsupported map family or unassigned shared allocation makes the result unavailable, never zero.
accounting.concrete_types: Enumerate every native TypeData kind and Rust counterpart. Go embedded Type header is part of each concrete object, never counted twice. Type pointers, data-interface words and Rust locators are charged as stored.
accounting.exclusive: One bucket per allocation. Type-owned caches belong in type storage; reference-only relation-cache backing is a separate bucket. Referenced Type records remain in type storage. No required storage is excluded from both.
accounting.external_allocator_slack: Report native allocator size-class/metadata slack separately from structural storage. The primary census includes container/page slack, not undocumented runtime allocator metadata. Neither side may silently charge one and omit the other.
owned: type/member/index-info and mapper backing attributable to types
type intern/cache key and value backing, buckets/control bytes and directory capacity
Rust type pages, locators, escape tables and unused or unreachable retained slots
accounting.shared: Deduplicate by physical allocation identity and full allocation extent, not slice start or pointer alone. Overlapping/subslices must map to one allocation extent. Charge mixed allocations completely to the most specific owning family; type-shared backing has precedence over other checker buckets. Retained source backing is assigned to bound inputs and explicitly reported there.
accounting.unit: structural storage bytes: concrete allocation object size plus actual backing capacity, directories and control metadata; count each underlying allocation once

adapter_work: P1 implements a real per-family census over the Go typed closure first. The 524-type pilot and fixed unsafe.Sizeof records are diagnostic inputs only; neither supplies this gate.
aggregation: Sum bytes and logical type counts over all 9,369 variant checkpoints, then compute aggregate means. Do not average variant ratios. Both type counts and Go storage denominator must be positive.
checkpoints: after bound input preparation, before checker construction
after the complete variant diagnostic/query/display schedule, with checker and all escaping results live
after releasing the checker, results, builder generations and bound roots (leak diagnostic, not gate denominator)

denominator.alias: TypeAlias is charged storage, not an additional logical Type
excluded: type count counters without a reachable record
denominator.rule: Unreachable occupied arena records are still charged in the numerator. Do not create dummy records or retain extra semantic roots to improve mean bytes. Report actual created/reachable/occupied/capacity counts separately and explain cross-runtime differences.
denominator.unit: unique semantically reachable Type identities, per live checker

observations: per-family requested allocation traffic, retained storage, freed traffic, allocation calls and capacities
raw Go heap/runtime endpoints with explicit GC outside timing
raw Rust live/requested allocation endpoints after dropping temporaries
type/signature/alias/mapper/cache counts, all roots and instance identities
roots: live checker semantic fields and caches (including interning caches)
query result handles retained by the fixed request protocol
synthetic nodes/original links required by those results
schedule: query-contract.json; identical ordered acceptance work and checker lifecycle to checker-workload.json
scope: P0 execution contract; no Rust completion or measurement result
statistic: (sum Rust charged_type_storage_bytes / sum Rust logical_retained_types) / (sum Go charged_type_storage_bytes / sum Go logical_retained_types)
